verdict.rationale: Working Copy is an iOS Git client with a built-in conversational Repository Agent that can browse, search, read and modify files and commit/push (docs-29, docs-64). That gives a phone-based AI agent working on your code, but nothing documents it reviewing pull requests specifically. The PR-creation mention (docs-19) is ambiguous and concerns creating, not analyzing. Missing for 10: documented PR/diff review by the agent, explicit code-improvement suggestion workflow, hands-on or independent corroboration of the agent's review quality.
